title: The Lake Road
summary: On Day ten, Nora and Ava finally see who was on the lake road.

beats.text: Behind us, the dock was full of heads. We paddled in silence.
Grace's message said four words. On the lake road. Stay quiet.
We beached in the reeds. At the tree line, a dim torch waved.
She limped out of the trees. Ava dropped the paddle and ran.
"Mom?" Ava whispered, and Grace caught her, crying without a sound.
beats.speaker: ava

beats.text: Grace showed me her hand, wrapped in a clean bandage. "Glass. Not a bite. I checked twice."
I believed her. I wanted to. I took them to the old hunting shack.
"Nora, are you moving?" Tess whispered. "I hear footsteps near you. Lots."
beats.speaker: tess

beats.text: Grace looked back at the road. "I'm sorry, Nora. They followed me."
